The '''2018 Rosemount Championship''' (RMC) was held on 9 June 2018 at Rosemount Middle School in Rosemount, Minnesota, for current and former Rosemount players. [[Mark Walseth]] organized it. 20 players entered. [[Bryan Mischke]] won his first RMC title, going 5–0 in the Swiss and beating [[Charlie Arlandson]] in the final.<ref name="rmc18">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=69183 Return of the RMC - 2018], forum.starwarsccg.org (23 May – 20 June 2018). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105004742/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t69183.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Rosemount Middle School, Rosemount, Minnesota<ref name="rmc18" />
* '''Date:''' 9 June 2018<ref name="rmc18" />
* '''Structure:''' 5 games modified Swiss (SoS), then single-game match play for the top 4<ref name="rmc18" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Mark Walseth]]<ref name="rmc18" />
* '''Field:''' 20 players<ref name="rmc18" />
